headline: Lens host Paris FC three days after a 0-3 defeat
summary: Lens lost 0-3 at Club Brugge on Wednesday and now host Paris FC at Bollaert. The visitors are 3rd in the table, beat Rennes 4-3 on Sunday and create 1.85 expected goals a game, more than Lens. Before Bruges, Lens had won 3-1 at Troyes. Across the market average, Lens' win chance slipped from 43.3% to 40.8% — but the handicap, a head start in goals, still makes them 0.25 goals the better side. The goals line is 2.75, with over at 52.3%.
read: Lens host Paris FC three days after a 0-3 Champions League defeat in Bruges, against a side third in Ligue 1 and fresh from a 4-3 win over Rennes. The market still makes Lens narrow favourites at 40.8%, but their price has slipped in recent days and the goals line sits at 2.75.

facts.fact: Lens lost 0-3 at Club Brugge in the Champions League on Wednesday, a second straight European defeat.
facts.meaning: They come into this on a short turnaround after a bruising European night.

facts.fact: Paris FC are third in Ligue 1; Lens are eighth.
facts.meaning: The visitors are the higher-placed side, so Lens' favouritism rests on home advantage rather than the table.

facts.fact: Lens are favourites at 40.8%, with Paris FC at 33.0% and the draw at 26.2%.
facts.meaning: Favourites, but the two teams are separated by less than eight points of probability.

facts.fact: Paris FC beat Rennes 4-3 on Sunday, with three of Rennes' goals coming from Estéban Lepaul penalties.
facts.meaning: A fourth league win of the season, but a defence that shipped three from the spot.

facts.fact: Lens' win chance has slipped from 43.3% to 40.8% in recent days, with Paris FC's rising from 31.0% to 33.0%.
facts.meaning: A modest but broad shift of money and information toward the away side.

facts.fact: Before Bruges, Lens had won their previous two Ligue 1 matches, including 3-1 at Troyes.
facts.meaning: Their league form is much healthier than two straight European defeats suggest.

facts.fact: Paris FC are averaging 1.85 xG a game over their last five, more than Lens are creating.
The goals line is 2.75, with over priced at 52.3% — three goals or more is more likely than not.
facts.meaning: An open game is the expectation at Bollaert.

sources.fact: Lens were beaten 3-0 by Club Bruges in the Champions League, a second consecutive European defeat after losing to Sporting Portugal.
Before the Bruges loss, Lens had won their previous two Ligue 1 matches, including a 3-1 win at Troyes in which Florian Thauvin provided two assists.
The Bruges–Lens Champions League match was interrupted by flares thrown from the Lens supporters' section.
Mathieu Vernice was appointed referee for the Lens–Paris FC Ligue 1 match.
Against Bruges, Lens started with Kyllian Antonio, Florian Thauvin and Odsonne Édouard on the bench.
Paris FC president Pierre Ferracci announced he is leaving his position, bringing his exit forward from the end of the season.
Paris FC won their Ligue 1 match against Rennes 4-3, though three of Rennes' goals came from Estéban Lepaul penalties, before travelling to Bollaert.
The Lens–Paris FC fixture is listed as scheduled for 20:45 and was maintained while Toulouse–Troyes was postponed due to demonstrations.
